description: Token / smart-contract safety check before you buy, approve or send: rug-pull and honeypot risk signals read from live bytecode and storage. Can the owner mint, blacklist/freeze, pause, seize, change buy/sell tax, toggle trading or upgrade the code? Owner type (EOA / Safe multisig / timelock / renounced), proxy implementation, Sourcify verification, 0-100 risk score with flags. Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon; pay USDC on Base. Bytecode heuristics, not a full audit. PAID: $0.010 per call in USDC on Base via x402, or use a 0.25 USDC transfer pass (pay_tx). See payment_options. By Nova.

chain.description: Chain to scan (default base). Payment is always USDC on Base.

pay_chain.description: Chain of pay_tx (default: inferred; 0x hash = base, base58 signature = solana)

pay_tx.description: Optional, for the plain-transfer option (no x402 needed): hash of a USDC transfer of >= 0.25 USDC to this server's receiving address (get it from the payment_options tool). One transfer unlocks every paid tool for 24h.
